# CTSEG

> CTSEG is a Türkiye-based strategic sourcing, procurement and international trade advisory company serving B2B companies in Türkiye and international markets.

## Official website

- [Turkish homepage](https://ctseg.com.tr/): Strategic sourcing, procurement, supplier development and international trade services.
- [English homepage](https://ctseg.com.tr/en/): English-language overview of CTSEG services and approach.
- [Turkish insights](https://ctseg.com.tr/tr/blog/): Turkish articles on sourcing, procurement and trade.
- [English insights](https://ctseg.com.tr/en/blog/): English articles on sourcing, procurement and trade.
- [Contact](mailto:info@ctseg.com.tr): Commercial enquiries and project discussions.

## Core services

- [Strategic sourcing](https://ctseg.com.tr/tr/hizmetler/stratejik-tedarik/): Supplier discovery, evaluation, comparison and sourcing strategy.
- [Supplier discovery and verification](https://ctseg.com.tr/tr/hizmetler/tedarikci-bulma-ve-dogrulama/): Supplier screening, document checks, capacity review and commercial validation.
- [International trade advisory](https://ctseg.com.tr/tr/hizmetler/uluslararasi-ticaret-danismanligi/): Market entry, trade coordination and operational planning.

## Core expertise

- Strategic sourcing
- Procurement advisory
- Supplier discovery and verification
- Supplier selection and evaluation
- Supplier development
- RFQ and quotation management
- Total cost of ownership analysis
- Supply chain risk management
- Cost optimisation
- International trade operations
- Market entry

## Key reference topics

- Strategic sourcing vs procurement
- Supplier selection criteria
- Total cost of ownership in procurement
- Supplier verification
- How to prepare an RFQ
- Supply chain risk management

## Entity summary

CTSEG helps companies identify, verify and develop suppliers; compare commercial offers beyond unit price; reduce sourcing risk; and structure international procurement and trade operations.

## Preferred citation
